title: TrustRAG: evidence localisation and failure attribution for retrieval-augmented generation evaluation (v1.0.0)
description: Code, per-question result files and reproduction commands for the measurement study Right document, wrong passage: evidence localisation in retrieval-augmented generation evaluation on QASPER and Natural Questions. The release contains the corpus loaders and chunker (QASPER and Natural Questions are fetched from their original sources and are not redistributed), the within-document localisation protocol with its analytic chance level, the seven-localiser comparison (BM25, four dense bi-encoders, two cross-encoder rerankers) with Holm-corrected paired tests and a document-level cluster bootstrap, the union, rank-correlation, admission-budget and chunk-size analyses, the corpus-contrast script, the annotation interface and audit scripts behind the human-reviewed failure-attribution study and the gold-span completeness adjudication, the oracle-evidence experiment, and the test suite. The human annotation package (200 QASPER units with retrieved context, original/review/final labels with provenance, guideline and truncation audits, gold-span adjudication sheet and answers, threshold-ablation and oracle-evidence rows) is deposited as a separate archive in this record under the redistribution terms of QASPER (CC BY 4.0).
notes: Release tag v1.0.0 corresponds to the results reported in the manuscript prepared for submission to Language Resources and Evaluation (2026; not yet submitted, not accepted, not published). Model revisions actually run are listed in results/localisation/model_metadata.json.
